exposure: type of antihypertensive medication prescription at discharge
cohort: 57,254 pregnancies complicated by hypertensive disorders of pregnancy between 2012 and 2018 in the electronic obstetrical database of Kaiser Permanente Northern California
finding: Discharge with a prescription for nifedipine alone or multiple antihypertensive medications (vs no medication) was associated with a lower incidence of readmission, whereas discharge with a prescription for labetalol alone was associated with an elevated readmission incidence.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was considered as a confounding variable and was adjusted for in the analysis examining the association between antihypertensive medication at discharge and postpartum readmission.
